spec.kitLine: Full Charge x3 / self: Gain Pierce
spec.assertion: Proves a gainPierce EFFECT sits on a chargeCounter count:3 self block. Fails under the nearest-wrong static hasPierce:true flag (asserted false — a boolean cannot step-gate pierce that starts only after 3 charges) and under a 5/8 threshold mis-key. Inertness: removing it leaves all three teammates byte-identical (pierceDamagePct is v1-inert).

spec.kitLine: FB enter / SR allies: Pierce Dmg 13.55%
spec.assertion: Proves target set is weapon-scoped: buffApply targetSlug set contains d-killer-wife + helm and EXCLUDES liter/crown — fails under the nearest-wrong {kind:'allies'}. Proves trigger identity: per-target apply count === fullBurstStart count, and the burstCast counterfactual cannot exceed it (with liter as a second Burst I she does not burst every rotation). Duration: expiresFrame finite (fails under a permanent buff).

spec.kitLine: Full Charge x8 / allies: Burst CD -7s
spec.assertion: Structural: burstCdr seconds:7, target allies, chargeCounter count:8, oncePerBattle false (kit states no once limit). Behavioural: removing it never yields more full bursts and must move her total (an inert CDR = dead code); re-keying it to the 5-counter changes the fight — fails under the S2a/S2b threshold swap.

spec.kitLine: Full Charge x5 / allies: Atk dmg 5.06%
spec.assertion: Proves bucket: stat attackDamagePct at 5.06 exists AND no atkPct 5.06 apply exists — fails under the atkPct mis-encoding. Proves target set: all four slugs receive it, and re-scoping to self changes every teammate's total. Proves counter separation: the set of chargeCounter thresholds is exactly {3,5,8} — fails if two counters were collapsed. expiresFrame finite (10s, not permanent).

spec.kitLine: 269.28% of final ATK as add'l dmg
spec.assertion: flatDamage atkPct 269.28, core false (no "core strike" wording — fails under a core:true read). Zeroing it drops her total and leaves all three teammates byte-identical, proving it is self-damage and not a mis-wired ally buff.

targetStatus name matching /wipe out/i, durationSec 10, authored on a block with target {kind:'enemy'} (validator requirement). Fails under the deleted boolean-wipeOut model and under an ungated rider set.

buffApply stat coreDamagePct value 16.26 with finite expiresFrame and >=2 distinct targets (fails under a self-only mis-scope of "Affects allies"). Gate proof both ways: with the targetStatus effect stripped the count is exactly 0 and every teammate total changes — so the requiresTargetStatus gate is live, not decorative. Every gated block is name-keyed to the same status string this burst inflicts.

spec.kitLine: Allies hit body: ATK 12.19% of user
spec.assertion: casterAtkPct is flat-resolved at apply time, so the assertion requires applies whose value exceeds 12.19x10 (a raw 12.19 would mean the caster-scaling was mis-encoded as a plain percentage), attributable to her by disappearing under the status-stripped counterfactual, and sharing one constant flat value. No-silent-drops disjunction: either the branch is modeled or 12.19 appears verbatim in the override's `unmodeled` record.

spec.kitLine: Buff depends on the area hit
spec.assertion: it.skip — the scope-lock boss is partless and there is no requiresNonCore gate, so parts-branch vs body-branch selection is unobservable; the parts branch survives only as a documented core-hit proxy.
it.skip — hitCount/shotFired triggers are owner-scoped; the schema has no cross-unit "any ally hit" trigger, so any encoding either under-counts (her rounds only) or invents a cadence (⚑).
it.skip — gainPierce carries only durationSec, no durationShots, so the 1-shot window is a ⚑ estimate; unobservable anyway while pierceDamagePct is inert in v1.

fixtures: controlComp('d-killer-wife', true) for every run — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / d-killer-wife (carry) / helm (B3). helm is kept IN deliberately: she is the comp's only OTHER Sniper Rifle, and S1b's weapon-scoped target set is only discriminable against non-SR teammates (liter/crown) plus one SR teammate. d-killer-wife is a Burst I, so the B2+B3 are load-bearing for reaching Full Burst at all; liter being a second Burst I is what makes the fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast discriminator non-vacuous. 9 hoisted runs: base + 8 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (gainPierce removed, pierceDamagePct removed, pierceDamagePct re-keyed to burstCast, burstCdr removed, burstCdr threshold 8->5, attackDamagePct re-scoped to self, burst flatDamage zeroed, targetStatus removed).
gaps: S1a "for 1 shot" — gainPierce has durationSec only, no round/shot-count primitive; the window is a ⚑ estimate and is unobservable while pierceDamagePct stays v1-inert.

Burst B parts-hit vs body-hit branch selection — the v1 boss is partless and no requiresNonCore gate exists, so the two area branches cannot be separated observably (parts survives only as a requiresCore proxy).
Burst B trigger identity "when ALLIES' normal attack hits" — all hit triggers are owner-scoped; no cross-unit ally-hit trigger exists, so any encoding under-counts (her rounds) or invents a cadence.
S1b pierceDamagePct 13.55% is parsed-but-inert in v1 — the magnitude is untestable; only trigger, target set and duration-finiteness are asserted.
